decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core, low-cost building block of the modular system with steady developer and educational demand, though the earlier relay withdrawal shows peripheral modules can be cut.
The industrial AC voltage input module supports the firm's industrial automation and energy-management direction, which makes it strategically relevant.

The server room kit bundles existing modules at low marginal cost, but it is a niche bundle and the most exposed to rationalisation as the platform moves to newer connectors and standalone controllers.
The recently launched RGB LED control module fits the building-block offer and costs little to keep stocked and produced in-house.
Remote access for wallboxes is a service-based extension of the growing charging and energy-management business, which is a strategic priority.
